name: web-botanical-dna-wellness-mobile-flow
title: Nine-screen mobile flow for a botanical DNA wellness site
whatItIs: A scattered layout of phones over a green gradient with small captions. Screens show a headline and photo, a sentence in giant caps with green highlighted words and a microscope image, an accordion numbered 01 to 03, a botanical ingredient card with a spirulina 3D orb, a gummy format card, a team row and an expert profile with a black pill button.
whatItMeans: Scientific yet organic; oversized light type and pale green surfaces keep it calm and accessible.
techniques: Mix giant uppercase statements with small captions and cards.
Use pale green tinted cards with a 3D object at the centre.
Number process steps in an accordion with thin dividers.
Stagger phones diagonally with short captions in between.

vocabulary.definition: A list where each item expands to reveal details.
A card coloured lightly with the brand hue.
Screens placed at varied heights across the board.
A rendered natural object as a hero image.
